test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. R sits second to the right of Q. Q sits in one of the corners. M sits third to the left of N. M does not sit in any of the corners. O is the immediate neighbour of Q and R. K is not the neighbour of N. L sits third to the left of R.

How many people sit between K and Q, when counted from the right of K?
solution:
Given that: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table

1. Q sits in one of the corners

2. R sits second to the right of Q

3. O is the immediate neighbour of Q and R

4. L sits third to the left of R.

5. M sits third to the left of N. M does not sit in any of the corners.

The final arrangement from the above information is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab29adde68ed9825521951bf1678008f3aeca1e34305c57646013ac174d0d383.png] 

**Three people** sits between K and Q, when counted from the right of K.

Hence the correct answer is **Option 3: Three**
